name: Dallas Contemporary
known: It opened in a Swiss Avenue warehouse in 1981, moved along Swiss Avenue in 2001 with Meadows Foundation money, and bought and renovated the Glass Street building under a $4.5 million campaign led by director Joan Davidow (2001 to 2010) (stated by the space).
Directors since: Peter Doroshenko (2010 to 2022), Carolina Alvarez-Mathies (2022 to 2024), Lucia Simek (2024 to 2025).
Board presidents Ann McReynolds and Rod Sager now serve as interim directors while a search runs, with John McBride as interim executive director and chief operating officer (stated by the space).
Executive director Carolina Alvarez-Mathies was paid $175,030 in 2024 (ProPublica, Form 990).
